lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Three years. The Saffron Veil and Hollow Kings have been tearing that same corridor apart for three years.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Nothing resolved. No movement. Same ships. Same losses. Same profits for whoever's counting.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: A schedule.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: That's not a war. That's a schedule.

lines.speaker: Gryph
lines.text: Kessler. You're bringing me business or you're bringing me problems?

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Looking to fence salvage. Clean inventory. Nothing hot.

lines.speaker: Gryph
lines.text: You're deep in scrap debt, old man. We both know it.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: I can clear it.

lines.speaker: Gryph
lines.text: You can't. But I've been patient. That patience costs. Thirty matches. Your operative as pit stock. Every match he wins, your debt shrinks. Lose three consecutive and he goes to the lower pit instead.

lines.speaker: Gryph
lines.text: Or I impound the ship right now and you walk out of here with nothing.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I'll do it.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Cipher, you don't have to...

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The ship keeps flying. That's the math.

lines.speaker: Rustfang Breaker 1
lines.text: You get three minutes. Disarm or be disarmed.

lines.speaker: Rustfang Breaker 2
lines.text: Go.

lines.speaker: Gryph
lines.text: You fight like someone forgot to be afraid.

lines.speaker: Gryph
lines.text: That's rare. Most prisoners come in carrying their mortality like a weight. You move like it's not even there.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: What happens if I lose?

lines.speaker: Gryph
lines.text: Three consecutive losses and you clear the upper pit. You go down to the lower level. Specialty markets. Neural components. Augmentation parts.

lines.speaker: Gryph
lines.text: The lower pit is where prisoners who can't be killed profitably go to be harvested instead.

lines.speaker: Gryph
lines.text: The gravity rigs rotate every six hours. Gives you time to learn the rhythm before it changes.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Why are you helping me?

lines.speaker: Gryph
lines.text: I'll tell you when the time comes. Or I won't. Either way, the debt clears by your sword or your corpse.

lines.speaker: Tisane
lines.text: New blood from the surface?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: First match in four hours.

lines.speaker: Tisane
lines.text: You'll get three. Maybe four if you look useful. The gravity rig rotates every six hours, zero-g, heavy, zero-g. You learn the rhythm or you break in the wrong gravity and become a stain.

lines.speaker: Tisane
lines.text: Lose three in a row and they don't bring you back up here. The lower pit takes what's too valuable to kill but too broken to sell.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: What's down there?

lines.speaker: Tisane
lines.text: Nobody talks about it. But the ones who go down, they come back different. If they come back at all.

lines.speaker: Pit Master
lines.text: Zero-G bout! Twenty-second grace period! Begin!

lines.speaker: Pit Master
lines.text: First victor! Clear the arena!

lines.speaker: Gryph
lines.text: You've won four. That's more than the pool expected.

lines.speaker: Gryph
lines.text: There's a prisoner in the lower pit who refuses to fight. The Rustfangs want her removed. If you bring her up alive, your debt clears today.

lines.speaker: Rustfang Corporal
lines.text: One condition. If she's valuable enough to refuse, she's valuable enough to stay functional.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I'll bring her up alive.

lines.speaker: Rustfang Corporal
lines.text: Lower pit serves specialty markets. Neural components. Augmentation parts. Prisoners with value can be harvested instead of killed.

lines.speaker: Vesper
lines.text: Seven?

lines.speaker: Vesper
lines.text: You move like seven. Like Cipher.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I have no memory. My designation is all I have.

lines.speaker: Vesper
lines.text: I was in your cohort. Third generation. Watched them pull you out of the staging compound when you were twelve. I thought you were dead. Then they erased me and dumped me here instead of finishing it.

lines.speaker: Vesper
lines.text: The Dominion didn't purge you because the conditioning failed.

lines.speaker: Vesper
lines.text: They purged you because you proved it could be broken from the inside. Your refusal at Kethel-7, that wasn't a malfunction. That was proof.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Proof of what?

lines.speaker: Vesper
lines.text: That we're not machines. That the conditioning can fail. That a Ronin operative can choose mercy. The Overseer could not allow that possibility to circulate. So he purged everyone who knew. He rewrote the record. He made you into a ghost.

lines.speaker: Vesper
lines.text: My own erasure stalled partway. They dumped me here instead of trying again. They thought I was too broken to matter.

lines.speaker: Vesper
lines.text: The vault core is three levels up, past the processing bays. This code will open the security door. The personnel files are still stored there, purge orders, mission logs, termination authorizations.

lines.speaker: Vesper
lines.text: Your operational record might still be there. If you find it, you find out why they were afraid of you.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: And you'll stay here?

lines.speaker: Vesper
lines.text: I'll hold the lower level. They'll hear us leaving and they'll come down hard. But I can buy you the corridor.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Classification: Purge. Stamp: Protocol Silencia.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: If you wake, you were right. Kethel-7 was real. You were right to break. Find Kessler.

lines.speaker: Vesper
lines.text: Find anything?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Enough to prove you saved me. The rest is erased.

lines.speaker: Vesper
lines.text: Deeper than a standard purge?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Someone came before me.

lines.speaker: Vesper
lines.text: The conditioning failures aren't isolated. I've seen fragments, other prisoners who passed through here, operatives waking up across multiple syndicates.

lines.speaker: Vesper
lines.text: Whoever is waking will burn the old order or rebuild it. Either way, the war is changing.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Vesper...

lines.speaker: Vesper
lines.text: Tell Kessler I said hi.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: The vault file contained a trace beacon. I was waiting for this moment.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: I want answers about Kethel-7 before the Dominion gets its closure. And I'm calling you Mirror because that's what the vault called you.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: You weren't the only one who broke. You were just the one they could never find a clean reason for.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: What happened down there?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: There was an operative in the lower pit. Ronin-3. She arranged my disposal as mercy, just drift instead of burn. And she left a message.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The Dominion didn't purge me because the conditioning failed. They purged me because I proved it could be broken. From the inside.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: She carved an access code into her own spine so you'd have it if you ever showed up. That's a long bet on a dead man.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Vesper. That's her?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Ronin-3. She's still alive.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The failsafe chip. It's not just me.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Vesper still carries one. Incomplete purge. Every operative who ever walked out of the program carries one.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: If the Dominion built it into him, they built it into all of them. The failsafe is not personal. It's a network.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Every operative. All of them networked.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Whoever controls the network controls all of them.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Debt is clear. What I'm holding is information rather than scrap. Gryph is done working for the Rustfangs.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Send reply: we'll talk.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I'm not the operative they erased. I'm the operative they were afraid of.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: You chose mercy. They couldn't forgive that.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: But others made the same choice. And if those operatives can wake up, if they can coordinate, then the cage is cracking.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: The failsafe network.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: We find out who controls it. And we break it.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: That's Rustfang's Cradle below us. Gutted ore world, run by the syndicate that holds my scrap debt. Watch yourself down there.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Set us down. The sooner the debt clears, the sooner we move on.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Vesper made it out. She's carrying proof of what they erased.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The failsafe is a network. Every operative they made is connected. All of them.
